productionContract.authority: CAP-13 remains off in broad-default and mechanical-only. Only a task pinned to strict-high-risk grants CAP-13 enforce authority, one specialist-review round, and at most one system continuation.
productionContract.sharedContinuation: CAP-13 and CAP-12 reserve the same append-only task/run-bound continuation unit. Repeated, absent-progress, exhausted, corrupt, stale, advisory, off, or legacy requests cannot schedule another model turn.
productionContract.reviewBudget: One review opportunity admits one current-tree bounded diff and at most two targeted reads. Review guidance, state enforcement, and tests agree on this ceiling.
productionContract.eligibleScope: Repair is restricted to exact semantically conflicting source paths and statically linked live executable companion tests inside Task Contract scope. Directory siblings, shadows, unresolved tests, skipped/dead proof, opaque shell targets, and outside-scope carriers fail closed.
productionContract.mutationAndVerifier: Only an observed successful tree-changing mutation consumes repair progress. Completion requires the task's exact configured verifier to pass stably on the new current-tree digest.
productionContract.classifiedVerifierRecovery: Inside the already consumed continuation, one retryable infrastructure failure may retry the exact verifier on the same digest, and one high-confidence eligible in-scope failure may open one final mutation-bound correction. Unclassified, tree-changing, repeated, or exhausted failures lock and hand off.
productionContract.finiteFailurePolicy: A review call denied by the review/scope budget, a failed call, a successful no-op, stale evidence, corrupt or missing repair state, path mismatch, digest race, or exhaustion locks the opportunity and invalidates reusable review credit. Policy denials outside the review transaction do not destroy valid current-tree evidence.
productionContract.unsupportedLanguages: Semantic evidence remains a closed finite JavaScript/TypeScript adapter. Unsupported or unproven shapes abstain or hand off; no parser result creates universal repair authority.
productionContract.rollback: Create a clean replacement task with CAP-13 off or use broad-default/mechanical-only. Existing receipts, journal events, handoffs, and terminal tasks remain immutable evidence.
